results.title: Inch by inch: With Winters' stop, Auburn savors opening win
Auburn beats Baylor as Enterprise's WInters makes game-winning stop
results.description: Trailing 17-16, Baylor went for the two-point conversion, but safety Eric Winters made an incredible tackle to keep the Baylor pass catcher just inches short of the end zone.

results.title: Falls City runners compete at Poth Invitational
results.description: POTH — Falls City runners turned in several solid performances at the Poth Invitational cross country meet Saturday, Sept. 5, highlighted by a seventh-place team finish from the varsity girls and a fifth-place finish from the eighth-grade boys.

results.description: Conor Daly the 34-year-old racer will be the full-time driver for Dreyer Reinbold Racing in the IndyCar series by 2027 Daly brings experience from his previous stint in 2024 with the team at the Indianapolis 500 The switch comes after losing his seat at Juncos Hollinger Racing
